statements.status_notes: The Snyk CLI ships github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.2+incompatible inside the upstream release binary that DHI repackages. Scout reports no fixed module version for CVE-2026-85747 yet; remediation depends on a future Snyk CLI release that upgrades this dependency.

The Snyk CLI ships github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.2+incompatible inside the upstream release binary that DHI repackages. Scout reports no fixed module version for CVE-2026-85747 yet; remediation depends on a future Snyk CLI release that upgrades this dependency.

Affects github.com/docker/distribution bundled in the devfile-gem Go binary rebuilt in the gitlab-rails package and shipped under /srv/gitlab/vendor/bundle. The shipped binary is on the v2 module stream at 2.8.3+incompatible. CVE-2026-85747 is fixed in github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 v3.1.2 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3). devfile-gem must migrate from the v2 module stream to that v3.1.2 release before gitlab-rails is rebuilt with the fix. That migration is not yet validated.

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is a missing digest check in the github.com/docker/distribution registry client: manifests and blobs fetched by digest were returned without being hashed, so a malicious registry could substitute content. docker/distribution v2.8.3 has no fixed release; the fix shipped in distribution v3.1.2 as commits https://github.com/distribution/distribution/commit/8f91c26c8888a95a36c2357a6e30bc15d4dd76d3 (manifests) and https://github.com/distribution/distribution/commit/93c6e1a3b3c874a73fbd6b8fa9b37577223cff9e (blobs). The docker 29.9.2-r1 packages apply both changes to the registry client vendored in Moby 29.9.2, so dockerd rejects manifest and blob content that does not match the requested digest. The module version reported by go version -m stays v2.8.3+incompatible because the fix is applied to vendored source. Advisory: https://github.com/distribution/distribution/security/advisories/GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is fixed in github.com/distribution/distribution v3.1.2 by validating manifest bodies against digest-pinned requests in registry/client.(*manifests).Get. The cdi-uploadserver binary links github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.3+incompatible only as a transitive dependency of github.com/containers/image/v5/docker, which imports registry/api and registry/client/auth/challenge but not registry/client manifests. A go list -deps build of cmd/cdi-uploadserver at containerized-data-importer v1.66.1 does not include github.com/docker/distribution/registry/client, and the built binary has no manifests.Get symbol. The upload server serves HTTPS uploads and does not act as a distribution registry client performing digest-pinned manifest fetches, so the vulnerable code is not compiled into this artifact.

The affected module is linked only through the devfile-gem Go binary rebuilt in this image; backup-utility does not invoke it. GitHub Security Advisory GHSA for CVE-2026-85747 lists patched releases at distribution v3.1.2 on the github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 module path. Replacing the legacy github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.3 dependency with v3.1.2 breaks compilation because oras-go v1.2.5 and docker/cli v25 still import registry/client packages that v3 removed. Resolves when those dependencies can move to releases built against distribution v3.
